summary.en: A LoRA is the same small adapter idea as Unsloth LoRA, dropped into models/loras and loaded between Checkpoint and KSampler. Trigger words, strength_model versus strength_clip, base-family compatibility, licenses, and ControlNet as the next step.
summary.es: Un LoRA es la misma idea de adaptador pequeño que el LoRA de Unsloth, en models/loras y cargado entre Checkpoint y KSampler. Palabras disparadoras, strength_model frente a strength_clip, compatibilidad de familia base, licencias y ControlNet como siguiente paso.
